events.detail: A deterministic check exposed a second half of the same timing bug: the queued pin is promoted before the first attachment starts the core’s pace shift, so it receives the cruise flight profile even though its entire visible flight occurs during the shift. I’m keeping promotion in the attachment transaction so the launch profile and impact angle describe the flight actually shown.
